caseName: National Hells Canyon Ass'n v. Federal Power Commission
caseNameFull: National Hells Canyon Association, Inc. v. Federal Power Commission
attorneys: Evelyn N. Cooper and Luden Hilmer for petitioners. R. P. Parry and A. C. Inman for movant.

opinions.text:
On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. The motion of Idaho Power Company to correct and amend the title is *1023granted and the Idaho Power Company is designated as a party respondent.

Evelyn N. Cooper and Luden Hilmer for petitioners. R. P. Parry and A. C. Inman for movant.
